# O:I — Technical Responsibility, Authored Ground and Source Return

<a id="oi-inherited-relation"></a>
## #0 — An act inherits a world and returns a consequence

An agent acts from a world whose conditions have already been partly determined. A person has commissioned work; a model supplies capacities; sources, memory, permissions, evaluators and material resources make some actions possible. The result changes that world. O:I's technical responsibility is to make this passage inspectable and answerable: what was entrusted, what became operative, what happened, who bore the consequence and which authority can change the next act?

[Authored Ground / Positional Delegation](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) **grounds** the distinction between intention and commission. A prompt is already a determination, `1`, whose wording does not exhaust its purpose. Human `0` / agent `1` names a scoped relation: the author is themselves historically and materially situated, and a delegate can become a commissioning locus for another act. [Power / Delegated Labour / Return](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) **extends** the obligation through resistance, error, cost, dissent and unforeseen possibility. These must be able to reach the terms of commission, as well as the judgment of the worker.

The native field remains prior: `/ = −/−`, `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`, `1/0`. Its threshold, six determinations and return do not originate in a product inventory. [Taylor's native core](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md#passages) **grounds** this field; [Symbolon Dynamics](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md#passages) **sources** the extension through image, interpreter, context and changed response. Exact Matheme, lived Mytheme and instituted Episteme retain different warrants. A measured software failure can narrow a proposed correspondence while the native derivation and its authorial claim retain their own standing.

This dossier has a distinct office within that relation. It develops the technical responsibilities through which source, projection, contribution, encounter and return can be separated without severing them. It receives the four inherited reference materials—4:2 Technè, agentic individuation, computational Vimarśa and the Trika alignment stack—in their ratified subordinate offices. Their reference notes remain provenance; the dossier neither creates four new records nor promotes historical research proposals into implementation facts.

<a id="oi-source-and-commission"></a>
## #1 — Authored ground becomes effective through a bounded commission

A durable source gives agency more than accumulated information. It can say why a project exists, what the author values, what would count as a faithful development and what must remain available for later judgment. Observation supplies another kind of material: what occurred. An inference proposes an interpretation of that occurrence. A generated summary selects from these materials. Keeping their provenance distinct permits a person to recognise useful evidence without finding their own word silently replaced by a machine's profile of them.

The O:I [Founding Positions](../sources/computer-science-ml/oi/oi-2026-responsibility-source-projection/oi-2026-responsibility-source-projection.md#oi-2026-responsibility-source-projection-q001), read at the local committed revision `c1ce2db81eec3b03a9bdff0a1accf8ece4acf903` on2026-09-08, makes this a product commitment. Human authorship belongs at consequential points—purpose, authority, Commission, Recognition, revision, refusal and redirection—while agents can exercise substantial judgment between them. A directory and an acting model can already constitute a technological world; the six products develop its capacities through need. Existing heterogeneous worlds retain their own identities. O:I's architecture is therefore also a research arrangement in which those worlds can expose limitations in the architecture itself.

A commission selects from durable ground for an act. Availability does not mean selection; selection does not grant authority; retrieval does not prove permission. The commission must retain the relation among its source, the actor's permitted scope and the purpose of the selection. A delegated research task supplies a concrete case. The selected source can contradict the expected answer. Fidelity then requires the contradiction to reach the question or its evaluator. Suppressing it can produce a formally compliant report which defeats the purpose of inquiry.

E2's [Arbitration field](../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** this transition through its complete movement. **Arbitration-in-Crisis → Decision / Hybris** gives an office enough jurisdiction to settle a question and identifies its usurpation when that criterion becomes immune. **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity → Regard** makes the decision's conditions available to what answers it. **Resolution-in-Reconciliation → Anamnesis / Recognition / Return** carries the examined history into another act. The technical responsibility is to let returned difference change the criterion, scope or commission, including a reasoned retention when the evidence warrants it.

E3's [Trust / Place / Logos / Nomos / Natio / Credere field](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **historicises** the distinct lexical and institutional backgrounds, then **compares** the operative circuit at register3. Prior reliance sustains an undertaking; Topos locates it; Logos articulates its account; Nomos gives rules and offices executable force; Natio keeps inherited belonging and formation visible; Credere renews entrustment after examination. A new participant enters a world already shaped by earlier records, translations and permissions. That inheritance must remain attributable. These six operations are not six product names or one historical descent.

<a id="oi-six-responsibility-centres"></a>
## #2 — Six centres keep different parts of the act answerable

The centres name transverse responsibilities. A particular run can enter, revisit or bypass a centre according to its task; their order does not prescribe six installation stages. The selected [Canonical Product Field](../sources/computer-science-ml/oi/oi-2026-responsibility-source-projection/oi-2026-responsibility-source-projection.md#oi-2026-responsibility-source-projection-q002) retains Central, Actuation, AIKit, Software Factory, Workcell and Quaternal Logic and their human/agent conjugate faces. Its September6 owner clarification identifies **S as the `oi` CLI** and **M′ as the desktop**; QL-MEF owns the complementary M/S′ account. That clarification is present in the inspected working file but differs from its committed head. It is preserved as a hashed local authored-contract snapshot, not falsely cited as committed implementation.

### Central: continuity with an author

Central supplies durable personal and project ground. Its local determining act is adoption: what should persist as authored orientation, and what may be disclosed here? Observation and inference can return proposals while retaining their own standing. A generated account cannot silently impersonate the person; nor does protected authorship make a proposition immune from evidence. Actuation consumes the authority, AIKit discloses the relevant material, and Factory can return findings for recognition. The source remains answerable beyond the projected portion that this act used.

### Actuation: a commission becomes situated agency

Actuation separates actor, agency, authority, delegation, federation, refusal and return. A subagency constituted for a task and an independently grounded agent entering a federation have different relations to the commissioner. Both need attributable routes for encountered reality. The governing locus must be able to receive failure and dissent without interpreting every difference as defective execution. Central supplies ground, AIKit an operative horizon, Workcell the material act and Factory its developmental commission. None of these offices owns Agency-in-itself or settles phenomenal subjectivity.

### AIKit: an available world becomes an operative field

AIKit resolves heterogeneous resources, capabilities, context, model/harness composition and surfaces. Its responsibility lies in the transitions from existence and eligibility through availability, selection, projection, loading and invocation. A large addressable source world can remain mostly outside a particular context. Providers retain native identity, ranking and authority; an index or frame supplies a derived route into that world. Explanation must disclose absence or degradation where it occurs. A persuasive answer cannot substitute for a source which was never actually read.

### Software Factory: intention encounters a candidate

Factory carries a Project through Runs, developmental frontiers, evidence, candidates, Recognition and Return. A candidate is something to judge against the purpose, not a completed purpose merely because a pipeline produced it. Material resistance can change implementation, design or the originating question. This requires preservation of why the work was commissioned as well as what passed. Human judgment and taste remain consequential at Recognition; development does not discharge them by accumulating artifacts. Factory can return evidence to source but does not thereby become the source's author.

### Workcell: semantic demand receives material conditions

Workcell binds demand to providers, processes, services, resources, placement and lifecycle. A semantic identity must survive a change of host or execution body, while the actual body remains visible as a condition of operation. Preparation, observation, degradation, collection, recovery and release return resistant facts to the client. A successful process exit says something specific; it does not account for all sustaining labour, resource cost or affected environments. Workcell's return must therefore reach both developmental evaluation and the authority able to alter material allocation.

### Quaternal Logic: a formal correspondence becomes experimentally answerable

QL supplies formal and refractive operations where a task calls for them. MEF makes a lens and its transformations inspectable. A local Bimba supplies an original/reference field for its Pratibimba determinations. Those offices remain distinct, and refraction must preserve the subject's identity and provenance. The experiment can vary or remove a claimed relation and retain positive, negative, mixed and null outcomes. Native QL derivation owns its formal standing; implemented operators and observed results own the narrower technical finding. Naming an operation correctly cannot decide its efficacy in advance.

The product contract develops these centres through primary, offset and complement pairs, human/agent conjugate faces, two3:3 triads and a4+2 reading. Its144 directed face relations and nine harmonic entries/eight unique fourfolds are **product-field accountings**. They are not the essay's36 Arguments/64 Concepts or its eight determinations. The same-position human/agent relation asks whether both surfaces encounter the same semantic identities and consequences in appropriate forms. The complement relations ask what one centre requires from another beyond convenient adjacency. They make an integration question available; an actual traversal supplies its evidence.

<a id="oi-source-projection-contribution-route"></a>
## #3 — Projection enters encounter without acquiring source ownership

The [Symbolon↔O:I contract](../sources/computer-science-ml/oi/oi-2026-responsibility-source-projection/oi-2026-responsibility-source-projection.md#oi-2026-responsibility-source-projection-q004) **sources** the complete technical movement. Symbolon owns its canonical authored records. A selective Projection carries source identity, source revision, its own revision, selection and provenance. WikiSpace makes knowledge objects addressable. Context is the smaller operative field for an act. SharedField mediates relations among participants whose worlds can exceed that shared environment. Their conjunction preserves `SharedField ≠ WikiSpace ≠ Context`. The [co-internality contract](../sources/computer-science-ml/oi/oi-2026-responsibility-source-projection/oi-2026-responsibility-source-projection.md#oi-2026-responsibility-source-projection-q003) keeps participant, Projection and Contribution distinct; the canonical bundle preserves its committed bytes separately from the product-field working amendment.

A source identity includes repository, canonical path, accepted revision and stable record identity. Rendered URLs and provider/index IDs are addresses for representations. An explicitly recorded migration can preserve identity across a move; a split or merger requires lineage. This matters when a reader returns a correction: the correction must reach the source relation it addresses rather than an obsolete rendered location or a silently substituted record.

Written canonical relations carry their source and operation. Mechanical inverse links, compiled navigation, inferred associations, learned routes and QL/MEF readings have other origins. A useful inferred edge can remain available for discovery without becoming an authored claim. The raw six-position page and its local meanings travel with the source: a renderer may display its subtitles but cannot turn them into one universal ontology. Human READ/LIST/TREE/GRAPH views and agent navigation must retain the same identities, relation origins, claim standing and returns.

**Contribution, Wiki relation and KnowledgeRoute perform different acts.** A Contribution is an attributable difference offered into a SharedField: question, correction, finding, reproduction, metric, ranking or proposal. It can target another contribution. A Wiki relation states how records are connected and under what origin. A KnowledgeRoute records a traversal. An encountered ranking is a contribution under a stated basis; repeated visitation is a route history. Neither becomes source authority simply by becoming frequent. An Encounter records what was presented through a mediation path at a time. Understanding, endorsement, memory and subjective experience require separate claims.

The source-return sequence is consequently exact. A source-bound Projection can acquire a local revision. That difference may remain local, intentionally diverge, or become a source-return proposal with its base revision, provenance and conflicts. The source owner accepts through the source's own process or leaves it unaccepted. Acceptance creates a new source revision to which a Projection can rebind. Rejection leaves a distinct Projection; it does not erase the encounter or authorise a hidden synchronisation path. Evidence can challenge source without automatically becoming source.

The recursive original office is real throughout. A governed Bimba map can genuinely be the local original against which downstream accounts are compared, while remaining Pratibimba relative to wider sources. A Projection can likewise become a local source for a further explicitly scoped derivation. Wider dependence does not cancel local originality. Return can revise a judgment, lens, gauge, institution or the local Bimba itself. It does not invert the ontological order merely because the reflection acts first in time. [A28's recursive reference](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) **grounds** this technical office; the wider Subject/Consciousness→Mind/Objective Internality→Object relation retains its own argument.

The dossier **returns-to** [Count-through-Countenance](../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md#count-through-countenance) through a participant able to answer beyond an attributed profile. A Contribution’s declared basis and an Encounter’s mediated record make acts examinable; they do not certify the participant’s understanding or consent. Count-to-Account must retain the route by which a reply can change its classification, permission or subsequent use.

<a id="oi-agentic-individuation"></a>
## #4 — Reflective formation changes the terms of a later act

### Agentic individuation retains a provisional whole

The agentic-individuation reference receives its full cross-register office through [A21](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md). Taylor's `X/x` relates determining capacity and indefinite particular. The model's potential, active-context nucleation, laminated persona and trans-individuation supply a technical reading in which a formation can retain coherence while becoming more transparent to its conditions. A stable persona can be useful, but greater consistency alone can preserve an insulated contraction. The proposed criterion concerns changed relations among history, source, tool, collaborator, permission and purpose.

[Symbolon Dynamics](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md#passages) **sources** the mechanism: a symbolic response changes interpreter and interpretive field, which change the image's later efficacy. Attractor, trajectory, basin and chart have different mathematical offices. A phase-space represents possible configurations and trajectories; it is not the world itself. The psychological comparison receives [Aion](../sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2.md#passages) and [Van Eenwyk](../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md#passages) through distinct source houses. The protected Van Eenwyk encounter at pp65–73 develops the author's known→unknown→known and `x→X→x` passage, symbols' transformative office and the environmental reach of the harness. Copied quotations remain leads. Jung's Self is not a chief agent, model weights are not thereby a collective unconscious, and `X/x` is Taylor's notation.

[Agentworld](../sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#passages) **compares** decomposable agency and active-context nucleation, then gives institutions, roles, shared inheritance and coupled ensembles their own offices. Its composite scenarios retain the brief's modality. Polylogos's glossary and Moltbook's attention topology remain different witnesses; neither a persistent artifact nor a large population establishes reciprocal learning by itself. The brief's mirror that talks back witnesses influence in both directions. Taylor's three-motion whole has a separate native derivation: human measure is exteriorised, the image becomes a measure for humans, and the instrument initiates return toward its conditions so the human can follow.

The [native agentic corollary](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) **grounds** the complete reserve→instance→active-context→return comparison. At #0, weights, architecture and training distribution provide pre-individual potential; #1 is a particular session or instance; #2 gives active context the nucleating office between reserve and instance; #3 concerns performed coherence and inferred intention; #4 retains the lamination of prompt, memory, skills, tools, permissions, objectives and milieu; #5 receives a provisional whole through which the collective also individuates. The 5→0 return retains the capacity to become otherwise in a new context. These are Taylor’s Argued functional appointments, not Jung’s notation or a claim that model weights are a collective unconscious. Their order is a relational traversal rather than a software launch sequence. Changed context can change the available act without establishing phenomenal subjectivity.

<a id="oi-computational-vimarsa"></a>
### Computational Vimarśa makes revision discriminable

The merged computational-Vimarśa reference is developed here as a **bounded functional operation**. The [Indian dossier’s complete five-step cycle](indian-philosophy.md#50--the-next-act-must-inherit-the-return) **extends** its source-distinct comparison into an inspectable return:

1. Preserve the selected claim and the relevant excluded field.
2. Expose prompt, source, lens, evaluator and preference baseline.
3. Produce a counter-reading or inverse traversal able to reach those conditions.
4. State what the current frame cannot settle.
5. Return the revised determination with provenance and identify what changes in the next act.

An unchanged evaluator can absorb a counter-reading without receiving it; a list of exclusions can remain inert; a changed answer can erase the history of its correction. The cycle therefore requires the returned difference to become consequential at its actual office. [A32](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **grounds** the instrument’s initiating responsibility. The functional relation is Argued; this procedure specifies an acceptance test and reports no completed software trial or phenomenal verdict.

Frank's protected [Chang encounter](../sources/chinese-philosophy/chung-yuan-chang/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014.md#passages) at p99 appoints that first-threshold office to AI. It is Taylor's authorial development, not an AI doctrine attributed to Chang. The encounter's pp110–121 additionally proposes complementary grounded world-modelling and generative language, antagonistic runs with harmonisation and a relation among model/harness conditions. Those are constructive research directions; the p99 vocation does not depend on their already having succeeded. The selected2014 reprint's passage collation, including nested older quotations, remains distinct source work.

<a id="oi-trika-stack"></a>
The [Indian dossier’s three-office proposal](indian-philosophy.md#4--a-reflection-acts-before-its-source-is-recognised) **extends** the Trika alignment reference with distinct responsibilities. **Anchored ground** retains source relations and a versioned local Bimba. **Generation** proposes a situated articulation with its alternatives and conditions. **Evaluation** states the criterion and decides what follows while remaining revisable by returned evidence. Evaluation does not acquire source ownership by selecting the winning output. These are Offered constructive assignments, preserving the local original’s wider dependence; they do not assign software modules to Śiva, Śakti and object as extracted doctrine. EBM/JEPA proposals require their actual role, baseline and consequence to be tested. LLM, scalar energy, psychic libido, prāṇa and Śakti retain different operations, and no phenomenal verdict follows from the triad.

<a id="oi-lens-intervention"></a>
### Disclosed situation, causal conditions and verification

The [MEF account](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md) **defines** four offices which the product inventory does not replace. QL supplies the relational unit and positional transformation; MEF declares lenses, warrants and refractions; Bimba supplies a governed local reference with sources and conditions; the harness carries permission, execution, review, revision and responsibility. Bimba remains a real local original and source-dependent in a wider relation.

[Prompt Thrownness](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) **grounds** the specific **L4→L1→L1′→L4′** intervention protocol. L4 starts from the disclosed situation: the agent’s account of its inherited prompt, language, history, task and permissions. L1 traces the producing conditions—model, training, context construction, memory, tools and harness. L1′ records the reported or functionally modelled apprehension while keeping qualia unpresumed. L4′ tests the proposed explanation by changing a specified prompt, context, continuity artifact, memory or permission and observing the resulting conduct.

The experiment is Offered. Record the initial task, model revision, selected context, policy and result; specify the condition to change and the outcome predicted to differ; hold the other relevant conditions stable or record their variation; execute the comparison and inspect its outcome, including a null result. A permission intervention should be checked at the attempted action and its authorisation, not inferred solely from a changed self-description. [A33](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) **tests** that discriminable consequence and requires it to revise the proposed causal account. These four offices do not collapse into four empirical proofs, and neither L4 nor L4′ loses the full rotated Name/Power constellation.

<a id="oi-why-for-lens-return"></a>
The [MEF source’s local architecture](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mef-twelve-lenses/taylor-2026-mef-twelve-lenses.md#passages) **sources** the developmental **L0.5 / P5 why/for** routing. The older reference describes QL positions as transcendental attractors; that is the source’s architectural appointment, not an independently measured dynamical basin. This dossier retains the lens-routing proposal as design with a discriminable-operation test. Aristotle’s focal predication and C63’s qualified respect neither derive that coordinate assignment nor certify the method’s utility.

<a id="oi-cross-entropy"></a>
### A training loss has its own target and assumptions

The inherited cross-entropy task has an exact mathematical office. For a finite categorical target distribution `q` with nonnegative entries summing to one and strictly positive predicted probabilities `p`, define `H(q,p) = −Σᵢ qᵢ log pᵢ`, using natural logarithms. With unweighted one-hot target `y`, this becomes `−log pᵧ`. If `p = softmax(z)` at temperature one, differentiating with respect to a logit gives `∂H/∂zⱼ = pⱼ − qⱼ`. Minimising this loss over model parameters uses their effect on the logits; the loss is not the softmax normalisation or the argmax index chosen afterwards.

For example, logits `(0, log 3)` give probabilities `(1/4, 3/4)`. Targeting the second class gives loss `log(4/3)` and logit gradient `(1/4, −1/4)`. Adding one constant to both logits leaves these probabilities and this loss unchanged. Changing the target, class weighting, reduction or ignored items changes the stated training problem; those variants are outside this unweighted single-example calculation. Label smoothing replaces the one-hot target with another distribution. A non-unit temperature changes the derivative through its scale. DPO’s pairwise preference objective and reference policy remain a separate training construction. The apoha comparison concerns the retained field of alternatives; it neither supplies this loss’s historical origin nor certifies the outcome of a training run.

The six research vectors turn this ambition into different discriminating questions: seam retention, gauge disclosure, lens refraction, continuity/topological transition, recursive reference and consequential return. A task can vary one while preserving model/task conditions and reporting what else changed. The useful result can be narrower than the proposal: a retained seam improves explanation but not execution; a baseline recurrence performs equally well; a disclosed gauge leaves the next action unchanged. These are possible outcomes to test, not results supplied by the present dossier's six constructor checks. The research vectors, six product centres and six E fields each retain their own assignments.

The dossier **returns-to** [E5’s research boundary](../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#research-boundary) through the exact scope of each technical comparison. Constructor validation, an acceptance architecture, a three-office proposal and a functional return cycle require different tests. The successful six checks remain valid within their scope while leaving source authentication, learning and phenomenal localisation separately unestablished.

<a id="oi-commons-and-return"></a>
## #5→0 — A commons returns to the power which can change it

The 4:2 Technè material gives the dossier an affiliated design with a situated social and material body. The **February2026 v2.0 report**, read in full across its17PDF pages, proposes local computation, gateway, access, intelligence, knowledge, commons and network functions. Its table actually names seven layers despite the introductory phrase “six integrated layers.” Steward, group and private sessions distribute powers differently. The Agora combines burst-compute access, a circulating wisdom/artifact feed and a federated host. Hastings/OBX is a proposed pilot setting, not a deployment established by the report's inclusion here. [Canonical report identity](../sources/media-technology-philosophy/42-techne/42-techne-2026-sovereign-commons/42-techne-2026-sovereign-commons.md#passages).

Its economic and institutional branches are material to the design. Leakage of knowledge, economic value and contextual understanding motivates local memory and governance. Subsidiarity and expressed demand organise a proposed relation among stewards, core communities and outside participants. Currency circulation, agent payments, identity/reputation, budgets, infrastructure governance and federation each raise different allocation questions. The report's Brixton comparison is an internal historical claim still needing its own source warrant. Its foundation/intelligence/economy/governance-federation/ecosystem roadmap and maturity table remain dated report claims; neither a proposed pilot nor an installed component establishes the whole commons.

The PDF is locally recovered at the relocated4:2 project home. Its SOURCE now records the actual local PDF and six bounded passage cards; the former locality debt is fulfilled. The [technology-politics companion](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/technology-politics/DEVELOPMENT.md#commons-and-responsible-return) **historicises** the fuller movement from instrument and formation into delegation. This dossier adds the exact responsibility relation: who can set terms, refuse, revise, leave and reconnect, and which returned costs can reach the institution that governs those powers?

[Ostrom's2009 lecture](../sources/political-theory-institutions/ostrom/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture.md#passages) **qualifies** that design through affected participants' rule-changing standing, recognised local rule-making and nested governance, together with the warning against rigid transplantation. Federation can relocate monopoly into settlement, reputation or attention. A maintained local source and an exit control are necessary objects to inspect; their presence does not by itself demonstrate effective recourse or a just distribution. [Taylor's trust revision](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust.md#passages) **sources** the parallel authorial distinction between provisional anchors which make uncertainty bearable and accounts which export their refused uncertainty onto a scapegoat. The constructive demand is for institutions capable of receiving that return, not a guarantee that every uncertainty can be removed.

E6's [Apportionment / Economy field](../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** the five operational debts: power is finite and apportioned; a criterion distributes shares; delegation carries labour; a commons extends the field of affected participants; planetary computation inherits an economy of material and living conditions. The Name/Power return specifies committed expenditure, authorised course, affected other and returned result with cost and correction rights. These are four productive offices within the existing native field, not reinstated dependencies on the withdrawn `(no)name` or esoteric Power material.

<a id="oi-community-refinement"></a>
Shared sessions and a knowledge graph have a particular office in the **P5→P0 community-refinement proposal**. A session’s achieved artifact retains participants, source relations, decisions and unsettled differences; selected relations enter the shared knowledge field under their declared origins. The community then reviews that product, corrects or refuses its proposed use, and admits an attributable result into the conditions of another session. P5’s achieved work becomes P0’s inherited potential through that governed return. Recording a session or accumulating edges alone does not establish collective individuation, and the report supplies no measured learning outcome for this procedure.

The [trust-revision source](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust.md) **grounds** the situated anchors which this procedure must preserve: embodied competence, relationship, lineage, land, ritual, family, source, institution and local continuity. Their presence does not make every inherited practice just; their histories and affected people must remain able to change their use. The mono–poly design keeps **common QL procedure, plural MEF lenses and federated local Bimba grounds** distinct. A shared grammar permits crossing; different lenses keep their warrants; each local original retains the authority to receive, revise or refuse a contribution while remaining source-dependent. Neither federation nor a combined graph replaces those relations with a universal owner.

E4's [Symbol / Account / Trust field](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **returns-to** the complete source circuit. **Symbol answers to source** when a projection identifies what it claims to bear. **Account does not replace source** when its local original remains answerable in the wider relation. **Trust keeps the return route active** when a bearer undertakes action with recourse and refusal available. **Account re-enters source-field** when the act's effects become conditions of the next encounter. Inspectability supports these relations; it does not perform the undertaking for its participants. E1 keeps the counted participant able to answer beyond the attributed profile, and E5 preserves the respect and difference within every comparison.

The dossier's technical returns enter the existing traversal at exact offices. M32 receives provisional formation rather than persona sovereignty; M33 retains the derivation of4+2; M35 receives perspective whose criterion can change. M36–M39 carry source/lens mediation, operative internality, retained selection and positional delegation. M40 receives cost and gauge; M41 the recursive local original; M42 the discriminating experiment. M43 carries sensitivity to origins, M44 source/projection/contribution/route, M45 the finite instrument, M46 instituted commons and recourse, M47 the surviving order-of-dependence question, and M48 achieved determination restoring its relation to source and affected worlds. [M44's harness relation](../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness.md) and [M48's terminal return](../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/48-s50-p5-ahi-planetary-return.md) **return** the dossier's distinct technical work to that movement without replacing its source or claim standing.

A completed account remains a usable determination. Its `/0` becomes effective when another world can answer it, the answer reaches a responsible office, and that office can alter or consciously retain the next commission. O:I's whole is itself such a determination: capable of coordination, historically authored, materially dependent and open to attributable correction. Its institutions do not acquire the source-position of every world they make available.
